version.changelog: Stale-base protection for updates: publish.sh now records the live version in .herenow/state.json and passes baseVersionId when republishing the same slug from the same directory. If the live Site changed since (another agent, Studio, a teammate), the update fails with version_conflict naming the live version instead of silently overwriting it. New --overwrite flag for explicit unchecked replacement.

llm.summary: This appears to be a legitimate here.now publishing skill, but it needs review because it can persist account credentials and create broad Drive sharing tokens.

dimensions.detail: Network access, curl, jq, file inspection, and selected local file uploads are expected for a publishing and storage integration, but users should understand that selected files are transmitted to here.now or returned upload targets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed as an npx skills add command and the artifact contains two bundled shell helpers; I did not find hidden installer behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most operations are user-directed, but Drive sharing can create write-capable or full-Drive tokens without an explicit confirmation step, and the share command defaults to write permission if --perms is omitted.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs agents to save API keys to ~/.herenow/credentials and writes .herenow/state.json claim/state data; this persistence is disclosed but should require clear user awareness because it outlives the current session.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Publishing local files and sites to here.now is coherent with the stated purpose, but the skill also includes private Drive create/list/read/write/import/export/delete and token-sharing workflows that are broader than the top-level publishing description.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting an agent upload selected files to here.now, store a here.now API key locally, and manage private Drive contents. Before using Drive sharing, require narrow prefixes, short TTLs, and read-only tokens unless write access is truly needed; confirm deletes and credential saving explicitly.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The shell and network capabilities are expected for publishing and Drive operations, but the artifact has no separate permission manifest beyond the skill text.
[TP4] unexpected: The Drive management surface is documented in the body of the skill, but it is materially broader than the top-level publish-to-live-URL framing.
[SQP-1] expected: The activation phrases are mostly tied to publishing or sharing on the web; this is not enough by itself for Review, but ambiguous publish/share requests should be confirmed before upload.
[SQP-2] expected: Saving an API key supports permanent authenticated publishing, but the instruction tells the agent to save it immediately rather than requiring explicit consent for local credential persistence.
[SQP-2] expected: Email-based sign-in is expected for account authentication, though users should be told their email is sent to here.now to request a code.
[SQP-2] expected: Drive token sharing is a stated feature, but write-capable and unscoped token creation lacks confirmation friction and is a material review concern.
[E1] expected: Uploading selected local files to server-returned upload URLs is part of the publish and Drive flows; the lack of upload/finalize URL validation is a hardening gap rather than evidence of malicious intent.
